o.text: From Proto-Turkic *taĺ-, *tāĺ-. See cognates at Turkish taşmak.

From Russian колбаса́ (kolbasá), from Proto-Slavic *kъlbasa which may derive from Proto-Turkic for "grilled cutlet" (literally "pressed on ashes"), from *kül (“ash”) + *bas (“to press”). According to one of the etymologies by Max Vasmer, the Slavic word (attested in 1140) is a borrowing from an ancestor of Turkish language (likely from Old Anatolian Turkish), compare Turkish külbastı.
